title: RoseStackerXchange
description: Addon for RoseStacker plugin. Allows players to exchange spawners they have for ones they want.
body:
RoseStacker addon plugin to allow players to exchange spanwers they want for the ones they have.

  config.yml:
  
    mobs:
    
      ALLAY:
      
        allow: true
        
        rate: 8
        

/rsx - Opens exchange GUI

/rsx reload - reloads config files (config.yml and gui.yml)
